title: Split Models
statement: Implement `solve(fields, secrets)`. `fields` is the list of field names on the write model, in order. `secrets` is the list of names that must not appear on the response. Return the response fields, in the original order, with secrets removed.
constraints: Secrets that were not present change nothing
hints: Skip names in the secret set.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A response model is an allow-list.

editorial: A response model is an allow-list. Building it by deleting secret names from the write model is the same filter when you start from the write fields and drop the secrets. A new secret field added only to the write model never appears in this list.
